ops.body: | Where I've been (the walk screen's unwalked-streets button, its veil, bold fog and "N unwalked nearby" pill removed, the fog always quiet; a fourth layer, "Where I've been", off by default on Navigate and Explore's main map, draws every earlier walk's walked line within 5 km in one even muted sage green under today's trace, never a count or date; each walk's line a cache of its trace, SQLite migration 30 and IndexedDB 23; WB1-WB17, decision 0222) | shipped | `claude/modest-johnson-pctfuj` merged to main 2026-11-18 | `specs/where-ive-been/spec.md` | no (steward, cold find and UI review only) |

argv: The pill went with the unwalked-streets button (decision 0222, WB1)

ops.body: - A tap on an earlier walk's line opens that walk: the layer's Return (the steward's S5); today a line names no walk and opens nothing.
ops.intro: What the Where I've been slice left out (specs/where-ive-been, decision 0222).

ops.body: - Simplification by zoom: every line is simplified once, within 5 m, at every zoom; a town crossed by hundreds of walks sends tens of thousands of vertices. Reopens with a phone's frame time over 16 ms while panning with the layer on.
- A date window or a picker of walks: the layer draws every earlier walk in reach (the owner's call).
- `usePastLines` on another screen first draws the last lines read, which may be around another centre, until its own read answers (well under a second on the web); a hook keeps no lines per centre.

- [ ] **Do:** upgrade from a build at migration 29 with several walks kept, open Navigate and turn on Layers, Where I've been. **Expect:** the app opens with no error; the panel says "Getting your walks ready…", then every earlier walk near you appears at once as a pale green line under the streets' names (migration 30, `walk_line` and `walk_line_tile`). (WB4, WB6, WB14, WB15)
ops.intro: The "Where I've been" layer and the walk screen without its unwalked-streets button (specs/where-ive-been, decision 0222). The web build ran the `where` journey; none of this has run on a phone.

ops.body: - [ ] **Do:** with Where I've been on, press Start where earlier walks pass and walk ten minutes, then stop. **Expect:** the earlier lines stay drawn through Start without blinking; today's green trace draws over them on its white edge; after Stop and the replay, the walk's own line joins the layer on Navigate. (WB8, WB9, WB16)

- [ ] **Do:** on a phone with a year of walks, turn Where I've been on for the first time and pan the Navigate map while it prepares. **Expect:** the map keeps moving smoothly while older walks are prepared one at a time; the lines appear together within a minute; the walk screen has no unwalked-streets button and the fog stays faint. (WB1, WB15, WB16)

- [ ] **Do:** with VoiceOver on, turn the walk's map with two fingers near the start (no Walk me back) while following (no Recenter), then double-tap the compass. **Expect:** the map turns north and VoiceOver moves on to a sensible element; the map's own `focus()` does nothing on a phone. (WB3)
